task.title: Registrar HA y production deferred boundaries
task.shortdesc: Indique qué capabilities de production, HA, reverse-proxy, restore y service-management faltan hoy y qué puede prepararse para design work futuro.

prereq.p: Existen readiness, network exposure, backup/export, monitoring y update-window notes para la instancia source-run actual.

context.p: Este topic registra la frontera entre current single-node source operation y future production architecture. Declara explícitamente what is planned but not implemented yet.

info.p: Escriba que la documentación BPM 0.9.0 Administrator/DevOps soporta source deployment, manual configuration, health/readiness checks, API examples, manual backup evidence, documentation rebuild checks y single-node update windows.

step.cmd: Nombre las service y proxy capabilities ausentes.

info.p: Liste packaged services, native Linux service units, Windows services, official reverse-proxy recipes, TLS/proxy recipes, managed secrets, authentication gateway configuration y production hardening como ausentes en BPM 0.9.0 source documentation.

step.cmd: Nombre las HA y upgrade capabilities ausentes.

info.p: Liste supported HA clustering, multi-node coordination, load balancer session affinity guidance, shared storage locking, zero-downtime migration, rolling upgrades, automatic failover y official restore automation como future work, no como current behavior.

step.cmd: Convierta future needs en design inputs.

info.note: No coloque varios source nodes detrás de un load balancer llamando al resultado supported HA. Capture required RTO/RPO, backup verification, TLS ownership, secrets ownership, logging, monitoring y upgrade-window expectations como inputs para futuras distribution/runtime tasks.

result.p: El boundary record evita unsupported production, HA y reverse-proxy claims mientras conserva preparation work útil para future releases.

postreq.p: Use este record durante manual documentation QA y cuando se aprueben futuros installer, service, reverse-proxy y HA backlog items.
